method: Direct local call to app.backend.services.analysis.analyze on read-only source clips; no API, account, database, or persistent video copy. This diagnostic captures prediction availability/statuses, not accuracy or user-visible timing.

clip_1.note: Matched the corrected API capacity counter: 6 available predictions, 3 history-building reps.

clip_3.note: Direct rerun of analysis on the same source/model after the API result exposed 8 unavailable reps. This confirms the current code quality-gates those windows; it does not establish the same per-rep mask was returned by the earlier API process.

interpretation: The initial video-jobs counter bug caused every availability count to be reported as zero because it read rep.prediction/rep.rir_prediction. The current API field is rep.rir. After correction, clip 1 has 6 available and clip 3 has 7 available; there is no evidence of a model/scaling regression. Clip 3 still has 8 unavailable estimates from the two-frame tracking-gap quality gate.
